scientific_question: Can measurements under one starting molecular graph policy predict which fixed replay experience bank will produce the greatest target-specific improvement at a matched generation and oracle budget?

starting_policy.warm_start: one common QED warm start trained on the qualified public construction space
starting_policy.initialization: Load identical policy and sampling-model weights into a fresh target-reward trainer for every arm. Initialize fresh optimizer, scheduler, RNG, and replay state, then preload only the arm-specific frozen experience bank.

target.qualification_panel: Freeze eight complete target fixtures by ascending SHA-256 of reaction-target-panel-v1|target_id before reading fixture contents or running target probes.
target.selection: Within the frozen eight-target panel, select one target by ascending SHA-256 of reaction-environment-selection-v1|target_id among targets that pass the frozen fixture, oracle-repeatability, reference-control, starting-policy validity, and pre-RL headroom gates.
target.identity_status: eight-target qualification panel frozen; final target open until oracle and starting-policy qualification

development.name: hash_uniform
development.rule: ascending deterministic hash over eligible starting-policy trajectories

development.name: reward_signal
development.rule: starting-policy reward signal with deterministic diversity and cost ties

development.name: validity_cost
development.rule: valid products and successful oracle calls per generated-action cost

development.name: scaffold_coverage
development.rule: greedy Bemis-Murcko scaffold and ring-system coverage

development.name: graph_embedding_coverage
development.rule: greedy farthest-first coverage in the frozen starting-policy graph representation

prospective.name: operational_hybrid
prospective.rule: frozen combination of reward signal, reliability, validity, and oracle cost

prospective.name: graph_aware_hybrid
prospective.rule: operational coordinates plus scaffold, ring-system, reaction, route, and graph-representation coverage

candidate_panel.membership_status: open until starting-policy measurement and freeze

graph_coordinates: effective coverage in the frozen graph representation
measurement.reliability_gate: Every predictor coordinate must pass its prespecified two-view agreement threshold before candidate freeze.
measurement.failure_action: abstain or version a new qualification protocol before training

training.budget_unit: generated molecular-action steps and target-oracle calls, both reported
training.replay_contract: Each update combines the common number of fresh online trajectories with a common number sampled uniformly from the arm's frozen preloaded bank. Fresh online trajectories are not inserted into replay.

evaluation.primary_outcome: unique qualifying-hit rate on the frozen target
supporting_metrics: known-active recovery as an oracle audit
decision_metrics: prospective pair ordering at every budget
incremental value of the graph-aware representation
evaluation.open_gate: All expected intervention-arm, budget, and seed artifacts pass identity, completeness, and infrastructure-validity checks.

before_prospective_training: complete utility curves and ranking prediction

later_nested_study.name: GINE versus GPS encoder
later_nested_study.status: deferred until the first environment-selection loop is scored
later_nested_study.reason: The first graph claim concerns environment measurement and selection. Multiplying the initial panel across architectures would confound that decision and dilute the prospective test.

open_gates: starting-policy oracle throughput and cost gate
